segments.an6.15:1.1: Tatra kho āyasmā sāriputto bhikkhū āmantesi –
segments.an6.15:1.2: “tathā tathāvuso, bhikkhu vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato kālakiriyā anutappā hoti.
segments.an6.15:1.3: Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu tathā tathā vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato kālakiriyā anutappā hoti?
segments.an6.15:2.1: “Idhāvuso, bhikkhu kammārāmo hoti kammarato kammārāmataṃ anuyutto, bhassārāmo hoti…pe…
segments.an6.15:2.6: Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu tathā tathā vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato kālakiriyā anutappā hoti.
segments.an6.15:2.8: ‘bhikkhu sakkāyābhirato nappajahāsi sakkāyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāya’”.
segments.an6.15:3.1: “Tathā tathāvuso, bhikkhu vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato kālakiriyā ananutappā hoti.
segments.an6.15:3.2: Kathañcāvuso, bhikkhu tathā tathā vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato kālakiriyā ananutappā hoti?
segments.an6.15:4.1: “Idhāvuso, bhikkhu na kammārāmo hoti na kammarato na kammārāmataṃ anuyutto, na bhassārāmo hoti…pe…
segments.an6.15:4.5: na papañcārāmo hoti na papañcarato na papañcārāmataṃ anuyutto.
segments.an6.15:4.6: Evaṃ kho, āvuso, bhikkhu tathā tathā vihāraṃ kappeti yathā yathāssa vihāraṃ kappayato kālakiriyā ananutappā hoti.
segments.an6.15:4.8: ‘bhikkhu nibbānābhirato pajahāsi sakkāyaṃ sammā dukkhassa antakiriyāyā’”ti.

lines: Imesu dvīsupi suttesu gāthāsu ca vaṭṭavivaṭṭaṃ kathitaṃ. 6.
Catutthe āramitabbaṭṭhena vā kammaṃ ārāmo etassāti kammārāmo.
Kamme rato na ganthadhure vipassanādhure vāti kammarato.
Punappunaṃ yuttoti tapparabhāvena anu anu yutto pasuto.
